program.name: Kick Power Long
program.subject: Kickboxing
program.blurb: Kicks with more behind them: power bouts and jumps, then knees and hip strength.
program.about: Kickboxing for power. One day is bouts of hard kicks and combinations, then jumps in straight sets for the hips and legs that drive them; the other is knee and clinch bouts, then hip-flexor and adductor strength. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels bring longer combinations and harder moves.
program.split: Power kick bouts & plyo / knee bouts & hip strength
